courses.overview: 由PON 收發機、突發模式與協議封裝連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect pon transceivers, burst modes and protocol framing to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 光纖到戶接取網路
related.why: 可移植「設備邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from equipment boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「設備邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from equipment boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理PON 收發機、突發模式與協議封裝；「光纖到戶接取網路」主要處理住戶接取拓撲、光功率與共享容量，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes pon transceivers, burst modes and protocol framing; Fiber-to-the-home access networks emphasizes residential-access topology, optical power and shared capacity. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「被動光網路設備」與「光纖到戶接取網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「距離量測」的對照方法至「連接點」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Passive optical-network equipment and Fiber-to-the-home access networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from ranging to connection points, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 相干光纖骨幹傳輸
related.why: 可移植「設備邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from equipment boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「設備邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from equipment boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理PON 收發機、突發模式與協議封裝；「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」主要處理相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes pon transceivers, burst modes and protocol framing; Coherent optical backbone transmission emphasizes coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「被動光網路設備」與「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「距離量測」的對照方法至「OSNR」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Passive optical-network equipment and Coherent optical backbone transmission flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from ranging to optical signal-to-noise ratio, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

history.title: GPON 系統 G.984.1
history.text: 本課的公開資料脈絡包括「GPON 系統 G.984.1」與「對稱 XGS-PON G.9807.1」。課程把介面和原理改寫為自行設定的對照練習，沒有重製文章、圖像或來源算例。
